Safety oversight programme — surveillance, audit, enforcement action. Regulatory harmonisation with EASA (retained EU law). Performance-based regulation transition. State Safety Programme (SSP). Mandatory Occurrence Reporting (MOR). Safety Management System (SMS) requirements. Regulatory cost recovery — charges to industry. International obligations — ICAO Standards and Recommended Practices. ATM Air Traffic Management — NATS, Airspace Design, Capacity National Air Traffic Services (NATS) — en-route and terminal air traffic control. Airspace design and classification — Class A through G. Free Route Airspace implementation. Upper airspace management — Shanwick Oceanic. Capacity management — slot allocation, flow control. Performance Partnership with CAA. Controller staffing and training. Surveillance infrastructure — primary/secondary radar, ADS-B, multilateration. Airspace change process — CAP 1616. Military/civil airspace sharing. Drone Drone Integration — UAS Regulation, BVLOS, Urban Air Mobility Unmanned Aircraft Systems regulation — CAA registration, operator ID, flyer ID. Specific Category operations — risk assessment, operational authorisation. Certified Category — larger UAS, passenger-carrying. Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) operations — detect and avoid, UTM (U-space). Urban Air Mobility (UAM) — vertiport design, eVTOL certification. Geo-awareness zones — airports, prisons, military. Counter-drone technology — detection, jamming, capture. Remote ID implementation. Drone delivery operations — Amazon, Wing. Hobbyist vs commercial distinction. Airport Airport Safety — Runway, Ground Ops, Emergency Planning Aerodrome certification and safety oversight — runway incursion prevention, taxiway design, ground movement radar. Ground handling safety — aircraft turnaround, baggage, fuelling. Emergency planning — Category 1-10 aerodrome rescue and firefighting. Bird/wildlife strike management. Airside driver training and vehicle operations. Terminal security — passenger screening, hold baggage. Noise management — night flight restrictions, noise contours. Environmental permits — water, air quality. Airport expansion — DCO process. Surface access integration. Airspace Airspace Modernisation — FASI, Performance, Digital Towers Future Airspace Strategy Implementation (FASI) — UK airspace modernisation programme. Performance-based navigation (PBN) — RNAV, RNP approaches. Digital/remote tower technology — NATS iTEC. Surveillance performance — ADS-B mandate, radar decommissioning. Airspace redesign — departure/arrival route optimisation. Environmental performance — CO2, NOx, noise reduction via optimised routing. Free Route Airspace above FL245. Military airspace integration. Cross-border coordination — Ireland, France, Netherlands. SESAR deployment. Crew Flight Crew Licensing — EASA Part-FCL, Training, Medical Flight crew licensing framework — retained EASA Part-FCL.
